source.author: Trevor Smith
source.title: Characterizing Desorbed Surface Contaminants Leading to Plasma Formation in Power Feeds of Pulsed Power Accelerators

observable.physical_interpretation: Published H Lyman-alpha and H2 161 nm Lyman-band central transition-density profiles across the anode-cathode gap
limitations: Samples from the same raster curve are correlated digitized constraints, not independent raw observations.
The spatial coordinate spans the electrode gap, not the foil width.
Digitization bounds cover estimated pixel reading precision only; no statistical confidence interpretation.
Published shaded uncertainty bands and dashed density bounds are deliberately not extracted.
Conversion to ground-state species density requires a separately validated population/emission model and experimental diagnostic normalization.

calibration.accepted_run_requirement: single contiguous run strictly inside specified ROI

digitization_estimates.meaning: conservative digitization estimates; not physical uncertainty or confidence intervals

csv_columns.pixel_x_median: Median exact-color x coordinate in the native embedded image.
csv_columns.pixel_y: Sampled y coordinate, increasing downwards in the native embedded image.
csv_columns.matched_exact_color_pixels: Number of pixels in the accepted contiguous central-line run.
csv_columns.gap_mm: Distance from cathode, from the linear image y-axis calibration.
csv_columns.log10_transition_density_cm3: Base-10 logarithm of the numerical transition density expressed in emitters/cm^3.
csv_columns.nominal_transition_density_cm3: Central plotted transition density obtained from the logarithmic image x axis.
csv_columns.digitization_lower_upper_columns: Bounds from +/-3 x pixels or +/-1 y pixel; estimates only, not physical errors.
csv_columns.wavelength_nm: Approximate displayed transition wavelength; 121.6 nm for H Lyman-alpha, 161 nm for H2 Lyman band.
